chapters.label: Live: the 2016 final
chapters.text: The 2016 Futsal Euro final, in Belgrade. Spain lead Russia six to two. Mario Rivillos has the ball far out, and chips it in. Seven!

chapters.label: Replay: the chip
chapters.text: Watch again. A soft, high chip from far out. Spain win the final, seven to three!

chapters.label: How he did it
chapters.text: His trademark: the curled shot. How he did it: start on the right wing, cut inside onto the left foot, and curl it round the keeper to the far post.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Practise it! Cut in, and shoot for the far post. Keepers find it hard to reach!
